scope.queries: up to four following unique draws within eight draws per seed
scope.assembly: reviewer-assembled consecutive unique ordinary draws; no public-worker/export invocation

manhattan.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define two-runs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
             (define markers
               (filter (lambda (cell)
                         (let ((v (third cell))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 2) (!= v 4))))
                       (grid-cells g)))
             (define (run-score run mr mc)
               (let* ((linec (obj-c1 run))
                      (r1 (obj-r1 run))
                      (r2 (obj-r2 run))
                      (row-gap (if (and (>= mr r1) (<= mr r2))
                                   0
                                   (min (abs (- mr r1)) (abs (- mr r2))))))
                 (+ (abs (- mc linec)) row-gap)))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((m markers))
               (let* ((mr (first m))
                      (mc (second m))
                      (color (third m))
                      (run (first (sort-by two-runs (lambda (o) (run-score o mr mc)))))
                      (linec (obj-c1 run))
                      (left? (< mc linec)))
                 (for*/fold ((gg out))
                            ((r (range (obj-r1 run) (+ (obj-r2 run) 1))) (c (range 0 w)))
                            (if (and
                                  (= (at g r c) 4)
                                  (if left? (> c linec) (< c linec)))
                                (put gg r (- (* 2 linec) c) color)
                                gg))))))))
